visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black hooded jacket, black pants, and a black backpack crouches on a textured cobblestone riverbank during a cloudy day. He faces the water, performing a rhythmic overhead hand-waving gesture with his right hand, looking back towards the camera with a slight smile and relaxed facial expression. In the background, multiple people stand along the river path near a stone wall, some observing the man or using their smartphones. (2) A large rodent, a coypu, swims from the gray-blue river toward the bank, climbing onto the uneven cobblestones. The man maintains his rhythmic summoning hand gesture, watching the animal closely as it approaches his outstretched hand. The animal stops just a few inches away, sniffing the air and remaining stationary. The scene is shot from a static, eye-level handheld perspective, capturing the physical proximity and interaction between the human and the animal in a public urban waterfront setting under flat, natural lighting.
